sections.heading: Why visit Amsterdam
paragraphs: Amsterdam (Europe) is known for its city, culture and romantic experiences. Overall it is on the premium side — worth saving up for, though budget options exist.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is April to May (tulip season) and June to September.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai.

sections.heading: Insider tip

faq.q: Where should I stay in Amsterdam?
faq.a: Popular choices: Canal Ring for charm; Jordaan for cafés; De Pijp for food.
